title: Android-userland: copy-bandwidth reference on the A520 cpu0 for the framebuffer scaling (NAT-181: 8.74 ms/frame, scales with core clock, not with instruction count): cached source 1125x2436 -> write-combined (dma_heap system-uncached) and cached 1080x2340 destinations, per-pixel and run copies, read-only and write-only streams, pinned to cpu0 at a recorded clock
acceptance: Own static test binary run by adb shell in /data/local/tmp, pinned to cpu0 (CPU part 0xd80), removed afterwards; no setting changed
Medians and minima for: per-pixel nearest and run copies into WC and cached destinations, WC write-only, cached read-only, cached copy; cpu0 scaling_cur_freq recorded
Conclusion which stream bounds the 8.74 ms copy and what a cached destination plus cache clean would cost
